bio: Ppz Olak, a respected member of the Cittadini class, has built his reputation as a master glassblower on Murano island through decades of dedication to his craft. Born to a family of modest artisans who migrated from the Dalmatian coast, Olak inherited their meticulous attention to detail and entrepreneurial spirit.
